promoted.reason: Independent acceptance, risk-based verification, exploratory/E2E/regression evidence, defect characterization, and readiness verdicts form a recurring ownership layer distinct from implementation, design, security, and release promotion.
Repeated cross-project work needs an independent owner for Cloudflare product selection/composition, bindings/configuration, edge/network topology, and provider-native operational semantics.

Schema invariants, indexes/access paths, query plans, transaction/isolation/locking behavior, migration safety, connection semantics, and engine-specific concurrency form a distinct recurring ownership layer.

Service-health objectives, observability strategy, actionable alerting, production incident response, recovery verification, and post-incident learning form a distinct live-operations ownership layer.

Declarative configuration/state/live-resource reconciliation, plan/apply semantics, drift, imports/moves/refactors, module/provider lifecycle, destructive-change review, and infrastructure recovery form a distinct recurring ownership layer.

reference_pack_first.reason: Official Flutter and Android corpora map cleanly onto existing owners.
Terraform/OpenTofu/Packer knowledge is progressive reference/execution knowledge under Infrastructure Engineering; provider-specific semantics remain with platform owners.
Browser/computer control is an execution surface; the domain owner keeps task intent.

later_high_bar.reason: High-stakes. Prefer bounded informatics/data/documentation workflows and current evidence over a generic clinical-reasoning skill.
